description:
Hyo-Woo, who was hated everywhere because both his eyes were different, was taken in by Sa-Gang and settled in his village. The villagers, who were waiting for rain due to frequent droughts, saw Hyo-Woo's eyes and accused him of being the cause of the droughts. Hyo-Woo develops feelings for Sa-Gang, who was the only one who looked at him kindly amidst all the hatred. However, Sa-Gang, who usually hated rain-making ceremonies, started holding them after Hyo-Woo came, and people started gossiping that they were holding the ceremonies because of Hyo-Woo...

Hyo-Woo's firm faith began to waver as he heard harsh rumors from all sides.

(Source: Peanutoon, translated) 

*Note: Part of Peanutoon's Geosi, Girong Danpyeonseon (거시,기록 단편선) Collection.*
